figs.alt: multifunction process calibrator setup powering a transmitter and reading its mA output

figs.name: multifunction-process-calibrator-calibration-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of as found and as left transmitter calibration with a process calibrator
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the calibration routine: enter the range, step through five points, check error against tolerance, adjust or trim, then repeat as left.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of a transmitter calibration with a multifunction process calibrator</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">As Found to As Left With One Calibrator</text>
<rect x="230" y="56" width="340" height="52" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="88.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Enter range, LRV and URV</text>
<line x1="400" y1="108" x2="400" y2="128" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="230" y="128" width="340" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="160.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Step 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 %</text>
<line x1="400" y1="180" x2="400" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="230" y="200" width="340" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="227.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Read mA, calculate error</text>
<text x="400.0" y="251.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">% of span at each point</text>
<line x1="400" y1="266" x2="400" y2="286" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,286.0 570.0,336 400,386.0 230.0,336" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="331.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Every point within</text>
<text x="400" y="353.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">tolerance?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="336" x2="610" y2="336" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="322" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="610" y="300" width="170" height="72" rx="10" fill="#16a34a" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="695.0" y="330.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pass, store</text>
<text x="695.0" y="354.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">results</text>
<line x1="400" y1="386" x2="400" y2="416" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="406" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="230" y="416" width="340" height="66" rx="10" fill="#d97706" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="443.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero and span adjust</text>
<text x="400.0" y="467.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or sensor trim</text>
<polyline points="230,449 150,449 150,154 228,154" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="140" y="346" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">as left</text>
<text x="140" y="370" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">test</text>
<text x="400" y="560" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Keep at least 4 to 1 accuracy ratio between calibrator and device</text>
</svg>

figs.name: multifunction-process-calibrator-error-infographic
figs.alt: multifunction process calibrator transmitter error example, 12.00 mA expected, 0.25 percent error
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working the article example: a 0 to 10 bar transmitter at 5 bar should give 12.00 mA, reads 12.04 mA, so the error is 0.25 percent of span.
figs.after_h2: Transmitter Error Formula With a Worked Example
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Transmitter error worked example from the article</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transmitter Error: 0 to 10 bar at 5 bar</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="740" height="110" rx="14" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="108" font-size="19" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Expected mA = 4 + 16 × (Input − LRV) ÷ (URV − LRV)</text>
<text x="400" y="150" font-size="19" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Error % of span = (Measured − Expected) ÷ 16 × 100</text>
<rect x="30" y="210" width="236" height="170" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="148" y="268" font-size="32" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">12.00 mA</text>
<text x="148" y="308" font-size="19" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Expected</text>
<text x="148" y="346" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 + 16 × (5 ÷ 10)</text>
<rect x="282" y="210" width="236" height="170" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="400" y="268" font-size="32" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">12.04 mA</text>
<text x="400" y="308" font-size="19" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Measured</text>
<text x="400" y="346" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">read by calibrator</text>
<rect x="534" y="210" width="236" height="170" rx="14" fill="#d97706" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="652" y="268" font-size="32" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.25 %</text>
<text x="652" y="308" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Error of span</text>
<text x="652" y="346" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">(12.04 − 12.00) ÷ 16 × 100</text>
<rect x="30" y="410" width="740" height="100" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="448" font-size="18" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Test uncertainty ratio 4 to 1:</text>
<text x="400" y="482" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">a 0.1 % transmitter needs a calibrator of about 0.025 % or better</text>
</svg>
